jobs.title: Survey Data Processing Officer
jobs.description:
* Process and validate data from mining survey measurements.
* Process survey data using Surpac, CAD, GIS, Agisoft, Global Mapper, and TBC.
* Perform calculations of volumes, coordinates, elevations, and topographic data.
* Prepare maps, contours, and survey reports to support operational and engineering activities.
* Conduct quality control (QC) and ensure survey data is properly stored and documented.
* Coordinate with the Survey, Mine Planning, and Operations teams regarding field data requirements.
* Report work activities to the **Mine Survey Sub Section Head & Survey Section Head**.

jobs.title: Environmental Planning and Permitting Lead
jobs.description:
Department:
Environmental Health/Safety/Occupational Safety
Location:
Nashville, TN
Compensation:
$115,000 - $145,000 / year

Description

Build your team in Tennessee for HMB! We are looking for an Environmental Planning and Permitting
Division Lead
in Tennessee
to join our team.

At the core of our vision is a commitment to being market leaders with engaged professionals that have the initiative, tools and opportunities to be their best.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the business development, operations and production effort for Environmental Planning and Permitting market
Fee proposals, Scope of Work, Budgeting, Invoicing, Financial Forecasting
Aid in the development of NEPA documents and/or permit applications
Assist staff in environmental planning and permitting
Collaborate with other disciplines and clients to complete projects
Ensure projects comply with applicable local, state and federal guidelines and codes
Hire and guide junior staff by providing direction and constructive feedback to support the market
Act as point of contact for Environmental Planning & Permitting
Development of project work plan and scope of work, manage projects and client relationships
Administer quality assurance for project deliverables
Maintain effective communications with clients and project teams
Ensure staff resources are deployed in a productive and profitable manner
Conduct regular meetings to ensure project needs are balanced with staff availability

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

BS/MS in Civil Engineering, Biology, Archaeology, Geology, Natural or Environmental Sciences or related field
10+ years of professional experience in NEPA and/or permitting
Ability to review environmental documents for technical and regulatory completeness
Demonstrated knowledge of all levels of NEPA and/or the environmental permitting process
Knowledge of environmental regulations and ability to interpret and apply them in project-specific context
Experience working with state and federal regulatory agencies
Proficiency with MS Office Suite, Adobe products and GIS
Experience in Leadership, Business Development, Client Management, Project Management and Production
Possess a proven history of meeting project deadlines and budgets
Ability to guide junior staff as well as participate in environmental planning and permitting

Benefits

Excellent compensation package
Flexible work schedule
Ability to work hybrid work schedule
Competitive holiday and paid-time-off programs
401(k) Plan and Match
Competitive health, vision and dental insurance premiums
Company-furnished life insurance
Short and Long-term Disability
Parental Leave
Variety of voluntary benefit options
Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
Flexible Spending Account
and More

Pay Transparency

The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Restoration Technician
jobs.description:
Company Description
Texas Restoration Group is a property restoration company serving residential and commercial clients throughout Austin, TX and surrounding areas. The team specializes in helping property owners recover from damage caused by water, weather events, and environmental factors. Texas Restoration Group focuses on timely response, quality workmanship, and clear communication to restore properties to a safe and functional condition. The company values safety, integrity, and customer service, working closely with clients during stressful situations. Team members are supported with training, tools, and an environment that encourages learning and professional growth.
Role Description
The Restoration Technician is a part-time, on-site role based in Austin, TX. This role involves assisting with water damage assessments, setting up and monitoring drying equipment, and performing water damage restoration tasks according to company standards and safety guidelines. The technician helps with mitigation efforts to prevent further damage, including removal of affected materials, cleaning, and application of treatments as needed. Day-to-day responsibilities include following work orders, documenting job progress, communicating clearly with supervisors and clients, and maintaining tools, vehicles, and equipment in good working condition. The role may also involve identifying and addressing invasive species or related environmental concerns during restoration work, while adhering to all safety and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications

Experience or training in Water Damage and Water Damage Restoration techniques and procedures.
Knowledge of Mitigation practices to limit property damage and support safe, effective restoration.
Awareness of Invasive Species issues and ability to follow guidelines for safe removal or control when encountered on job sites.
Strong Communication skills for working with team members, supervisors, and customers.
Ability to perform physical labor, including lifting, bending, and working in varied indoor and outdoor conditions.
Basic understanding of hand tools, restoration equipment, and safe work practices.
Reliability in following schedules, instructions, and documentation procedures.
High school diploma or equivalent; relevant restoration or mitigation certifications are a plus.
Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation to job sites in the Austin, TX area.
